WHAT TO FLAG — an "invented operational parameter" means a NUMBER (or numeric threshold/limit/budget/quota/retry-count/percentage/duration) newly introduced by this diff that CONTROLS WORKER OR USER POLICY: e.g. how many workers/agents may run, how long a worker may run before being cut off, how many retries a user gets, a size/rate cap enforced against a person or an agent, a budget or quota, a staleness window that gates someone's work, a "maximum N" that a human or agent must obey.

- ordinary test timeouts and sleeps in test code
- parser indexes, slice bounds, array offsets, column counts, regex group numbers
- counted source data: row counts, line counts, byte counts, anchor counts, "23 parts", "540 rows", "400 anchors", "122" — numbers that simply COUNT what is really in the files
- version numbers, dates, commit hashes, requirement/anchor IDs (INV-273, M-555, T-14, r08 etc.)
- pre-existing numbers merely MOVED from one file to another by the split (the whole point of the diff is moving text verbatim). A number that existed on the 9870c7b8 side and just relocated into matrix/*.md is NOT invented.
- prose-length caps or census counts that already existed before this diff

2. Run `git diff 9870c7b8 HEAD --stat` to see scope.
3. For every ADDED line (lines starting with '+') that contains a digit, decide whether it is an invented policy parameter per the rules above.
4. CRUCIAL: for any candidate you find, verify whether it is genuinely NEW by checking if the same number/text existed at the base: `git show 9870c7b8:<path> | grep -n '<pattern>'` and also search the whole base tree: `git grep -n '<pattern>' 9870c7b8`.    - guardrails/pre-push

   - scaffold/guardrails/check_conflicts.py
   - guardrails/rule-census.json
   - scripts/check-registry.json

- If you find none, say "NO INVENTED POLICY PARAMETERS FOUND" and briefly list the main categories of numbers you did see and why each was benign.
Be rigorous but do not pad the report. Do not report benign numbers as findings.
